name: Paneer Stuffed Mushrooms
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 8 large button mushrooms, stems removed and finely chopped
½ tsp each black pepper, oregano and chilli flakes
steps: Heat the oil and cook the garlic and chopped mushroom stems for 3 minutes. Add the spinach and cook 2 minutes.
Mix with the paneer, spices, coriander and salt.
Fill the mushroom caps and place on a lined tray.
Bake for 15–18 minutes until the mushrooms are tender and the tops lightly golden.
note: Low-carbohydrate and high in protein; serve with a salad for a light meal.
